t2.thesis: AMD has fallen about 25% in a month on Intel's PC warning and AI-capex worries, so a solid data-center guide could spark a relief move, but its poor recent reaction record and a 9% implied move make this close to a coin flip.
reasons: Semis base rate (0.479) sits below the buy-everything bar; AMD's last 4 prints won only 25% at exit A, including -14.5% on a 15% EPS beat
Sentiment is already washed out: -25% in 1m, -11% in 5d, 27% below the 52w high, with volume 20d/250d at 0.63, which lowers the bar for a relief rally
Fundamental momentum is intact: Q3 guide of $13B (+13% q/q), management calling for DC acceleration in H2, EPS estimates revised up 4.8% over 90d
Options lean bullish: ATM call IV is above put IV (+0.20) and put skew is negative, though put/call volume is 1.36
The outcome hinges on the Q4 and 2027 data-center/MI450/Helios guide against high buy-side whisper expectations (Susquehanna's $74B 2027 DC forecast)
t2.deciding_variable: The Q4 2026 revenue guide and any quantified 2027 Instinct/Helios (MI450) ramp commentary, compared with buy-side expectations of a large Q4 step-up.

prior.from: I3 by_cluster semis t0_hit 0.479 (n=434), nudged slightly up toward overall 0.541 and AMC 0.538 because AMD also sits partly in ai_infra (0.558)

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That earnings report is scheduled for tomorrow (2026-11-03), so the stock's reaction hasn't happened yet.
t2.moved_from_prior: Up about +2pts in total. The deep pre-print drawdown and bullish call/put IV spread add roughly +4pts, and the positive revision trend with a strong prior guide adds about +1pt. Against that, AMD's history of selling off on beats, the Intel PC read-through and the World Labs share dilution take off about -3pts.

theses.mechanism: The selloff has reset expectations. A Q4 guide above about $14.5B with confirmed MI450/Helios shipments on schedule (OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic) triggers short-covering and a relief rally from depressed levels
theses.wrong_if: The Q4 guide is merely in line, or Helios revenue timing slips into 2027

theses.mechanism: This repeats the 'beat but not enough' pattern seen in Feb and Aug 2026. Client weakness echoing Intel's PC warning and gaming declines offset data-center upside while whisper numbers stay high
theses.wrong_if: Data-center revenue clearly beats and the guide is raised well above consensus

theses.mechanism: With implied move at 9% and IV/RV at 2.1, results land near expectations, IV crush dominates, and the open stays within a few percent of the Nov 3 entry open
theses.wrong_if: Guidance surprises materially in either direction

key_observations: Q4 revenue guide vs consensus, and the implied q/q growth
Data-center segment revenue vs the ~$6.7B Q2 base, plus the EPYC vs Instinct split
MI450/Helios shipment timing and any 2027 AI GPU revenue figure
Client segment commentary relative to Intel's PC warning
Nov 3 session drift into the print, which moves the entry open's starting point
